gw_collect.log.clock_synced: GW collect: the server clock is synchronised — the traffic of the exits and the quotas are counted again
gw_collect.log.clock_unsynced: GW collect: the server clock is not synchronised — the traffic of the exits and the quotas are not counted for now (a time service is needed: chrony or systemd-timesyncd; turn it on: timedatectl set-ntp true)
gw_collect.log.flush_no_conntrack: GW repair: conntrack is not installed — old client connections were not reset (gw_fwd drops them)
gw_collect.log.flushed: GW repair: client connections of {base} reset ({n})
gw_collect.log.moved: GW after reboot: devices moved to other exits — {moves}
gw_collect.log.nested_lock: GW collect: ERROR — the state lock nested ({where}): {error}; the round was not done
gw_collect.log.pool_busy: GW collect: the pool of exits is busy (egress_pool_locked) — the deleted exits leave the groups at a later round
gw_collect.log.renumbered: GW exits: pool lines {lines} changed their exit — client connections through them were reset ({n})
gw_collect.log.renumbered_no_conntrack: GW exits: pool lines {lines} changed their exit — conntrack is not installed, old client connections were not reset (they reconnect on their own)
gw_collect.log.routing_restored: GW repair: gateway routing (fail-safe ip rules 31998/31999 and table 199, ip rules 0x200 and 0x300, table 200, kgw0) — restored
gw_collect.log.ru_guard: GW collect: the last line tripped — Russia direct without the ⚠RU confirmation is not applied ({n}); the admin is told
gw_collect.log.table_restored: GW repair: the gateway part of the nftables table was missing — restored
gw_collect.log.xray_rejected: GW collect: xray refused the config of the collector — {error}; the same config is not tested again more often than once in 5 min
gw_collect.log.xray_ru_closed_allowed: GW collect: Russia direct is allowed again ({n}) — the choice or the ⚠RU confirmation is back, the gateway xray was not restarted
gw_collect.log.xray_ru_closed_restarted: GW collect: Russia direct without the choice or the ⚠RU confirmation is closed ({n}) — the gateway xray restarted with the current settings or is stopped
gw_collect.log.xray_ru_closed_stopped: GW collect: Russia direct without the choice or the ⚠RU confirmation is closed ({n}) — the gateway xray is stopped: SOCKS5 and VLESS don’t work until xray takes a new config
gw_collect.log.xray_ru_open: GW collect: the gateway xray couldn’t be stopped when Russia direct had to be closed ({n}) — for users without the “Russia direct” choice or the ⚠RU confirmation it may still go directly; the collector tries to close it on every tick
